_doc: Glint-V2 routing policy. First-match-wins for overrides. Hot-reload via POST /reload. See README for context.
_doc_overrides: Each override is a condition -> action. First match wins. Conditions evaluated top-to-bottom. Specific conditions above catch-alls. override_only tiers are only reachable via these (never via cost arithmetic).

overrides.name: vision_routing
overrides._doc: Image in message -> vision tier. Always wins.

overrides.name: owui_background_task
overrides._doc: OWUI meta-tasks ('### Task:', 'generate title', 'suggest follow-up'). These trip false code/math flags on the router; route to tier0.

overrides.name: medical_keyword
overrides._doc: Medical/health keywords (drug names, clinical terms, patient language). Routes to medical tier regardless of cost.

overrides.name: freshness_simple
overrides._doc: Freshness signals (today/current/latest/news) + low complexity -> tier0 (fast + small model can answer weather/breaking-news).

overrides.name: structural_prototype_hard_coding
overrides._doc: Structural prototypes (system_design, complex_debugging) -> tier4 (Laguna). Prototypes are STRUCTURAL ONLY (kind: structural).
overrides.condition: prototype_match(kind='structural', name='hard_programming', threshold=0.85) OR prototype_match(kind='structural', name='system_design', threshold=0.85)

overrides.name: low_complexity_default
overrides.condition: router_complexity <= 2 AND NOT router_flag_code AND NOT router_flag_math AND NOT router_flag_reasoning

_doc_regexes: All regexes are case-insensitive (?i implied). Update carefully; these run on every request.
medical_keyword_regex: \b(metformin|lisinopril|atorvastatin|levothyroxine|amlodipine|metoprolol|albuterol|omeprazole|losartan|gabapentin|hydrochlorothiazide|sertraline|simvastatin|ibuprofen|acetaminophen|amoxicillin|insulin|aspirin|warfarin|prednisone|tramadol|azithromycin|amitriptyline|naproxen|hydrocodone|ciprofloxacin|fluoxetine|propranolol|diazepam|doxycycline|clonazepam|prescribed|prescription|dosage|mg/kg|side effects?|contraindications?|symptoms?|diagnosis|prognosis|treatment|therapy|clinical|patient|my doctor|my physician|my nurse|i've been diagnosed|i was prescribed|side effect|adverse reaction|drug interaction|pharmacy|pharmacist|rx\b|medication|medicine|pill|tablet|capsule|injection|vaccine|vaccination|immunization|disease|disorder|syndrome|chronic|acute|benign|malignant|tumor|cancer|diabetes|hypertension|depression|anxiety|bipolar|adhd|allergy|asthma|arthritis|cardiac|stroke|seizure|migraine|psychiatric|psychiatric|antibiotic|antiviral|antifungal|antidepressant|antihistamine)\b
owui_task_regex: (?i)\b### Task:\b|\b(generate a concise title|generate 1-3 broad tags|suggest 3-5 follow-up|respond with inline citations|summarize the following into)\b
_doc_prototype_thresholds: Per-prototype similarity threshold for matching. Higher = stricter. Keep thresholds high to avoid Glint's Roman-Empire-medical false-positive lesson.
_doc_calibration: Temperature scaling applied to router softmax. Higher temperature = softer probabilities (more escalation). Lower = sharper.

calibration._doc_temperature: Default 1.0. Increase (e.g., 1.3) if too many escalations; decrease (e.g., 0.7) if too few.

_doc_ladder: When chosen tier is unavailable (breaker open, error, context overflow), how to walk.

ladder._doc_walk_up: If prompt exceeds tier max_context, try tier with larger context (tier2 -> tier3 -> tier4 -> tier3_external).
ladder._doc_reserve: Reserve this % of max_context as KV buffer.
ladder._doc_fallback: On endpoint error, retry once on configured fallback endpoint; on second failure, return 503.
ladder._doc_skip: If any endpoint in the tier is in breaker OPEN state, skip the whole tier (move to next tier in ladder).

_doc_efficiency: Tie-break when costs are within margin. prefer_healthier: skip endpoints in OPEN state. prefer_lower_load: prefer endpoints with fewer inflight requests.

logging._doc_log_full_prompt: Full prompt logging is a privacy risk; disabled by default. Enable for debugging only.

_doc_memory: Three-tier memory + Observational Memory (Mastra pattern). All threads/users accumulate history; OM compresses when tokens cross thresholds.

memory._doc_sem_recall: Set to 3+ to enable L3 semantic recall. Off by default — costs an embedding per stored message. Enable when 'search past conversations' is a real user job.
memory._doc_message_tokens: Threshold of unobserved-message tokens in a thread that triggers the Observer. Lower = more frequent compression, fresher observations.
memory._doc_observation_tokens: Threshold of observation tokens that triggers the Reflector. Lower = more frequent condensation.
memory._doc_compaction_pct: When memory context exceeds this % of tier's max_context, the gateway redirects to a higher tier with larger context window.
memory._doc_observer_tier: Small fast model for compression work. Per Mastra: 'Observer model is a cost lever, not a quality one'. Tier0 is the default.

_doc_events: Event emitter config (OWUI thinking indicator pattern). UI platforms subscribe via SSE at /events.
_doc_swarm: Swarm/synthesis mode: decompose complex requests into parallel subtasks across tiers, then synthesize. Off by default. mode: off | auto | always. auto triggers when cost-first picks a trigger_tier AND complexity >= min_complexity AND a swarm-eligible flag is set. Swarm only runs if its expected cost is below max_swarm_cost_usd.
_doc_translation: Translation-intent handling. mode: off | detect_only | rewrite | dedicated_endpoint. detect_only tags the decision without changing routing. rewrite injects a translator system prompt.
